name: AL2X Editorial IA
author: AxisoSystem

sections.description:
AL2X Editorial IA is an editorial support plugin for newsrooms publishing on WordPress. It helps journalists and editors turn a raw text draft into a structured article by suggesting:

  • Alternative headlines
  • A bullet-point summary
  • Pull quotes (highlighted excerpts)
  • Meta description and SEO keywords
  • Internal consistency checks on the text itself (dates, names and numbers that contradict each other)
  • Legal-risk language alerts, as editorial support (Pro plan feature)

Processing is handled through a secure relay service operated by Axio Systems, using a license key tied to the site’s domain. No content is published automatically — the editor always reviews and chooses what to apply before inserting it into the block editor, and final publication remains exclusively the user’s decision.

The plugin requires an active subscription (Basic or Pro plan) to work. More details, plans and sign-up at axiosystem.com.br/axio-plugins.

What the plugin does NOT do

  • It does not publish content autonomously.
  • It does not perform external fact-checking — the consistency check only looks at the text pasted by the user.
  • It does not replace professional legal review.
  • It does not store a copy of the article text on Axio Systems servers (only usage metadata).
  • It does not work on Pages, only on Posts, and requires the Block Editor (Gutenberg) for automatic insertion.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to AL2X Editorial IA in the admin sidebar and paste the license key provided after subscribing.
  4. Open a Post and use the AL2X Editorial IA — Structure Article box below the main editor.
sections.faq:
Do I need a subscription to use the plugin?

Yes. The plugin is free to install, but AI processing requires an active license (Basic or Pro plan), tied to the site’s domain.

Does the plugin work with the Classic Editor?

Automatic insertion of content into blocks requires the Block Editor (Gutenberg). In the Classic Editor, the result is shown on screen for manual copy-pasting.

Is my data kept secure?

Payment data is processed by the payment intermediary (Mercado Pago), without Axio Systems having access to full card data. The article text is processed to generate the structured output, but is not stored permanently. More details in the Privacy Policy.
sections.changelog:
0.7.0

  • Renames the plugin to AL2X Editorial IA (display name, slug and text domain), resolving a second trademark conflict.

0.6.0

  • Renames the plugin to Lide Editorial AI (display name, slug and text domain).

0.5.1

  • Moves inline admin JavaScript to a properly enqueued script file (wp_enqueue_script/wp_localize_script).
  • Adds the painelpolitico account to Contributors.

0.5.0

  • Adds GPLv2 license header and standard plugin metadata.
  • Internationalizes (i18n) all admin interface strings with the al2x-editorial-ia text domain.
  • Strengthens sanitization of tab navigation (sanitize_key/wp_unslash) and output escaping.
  • Adds readme.txt file for the WordPress.org plugin directory.
  • Updates “Tested up to” to the current WordPress version.

0.4.1

  • Internal stability adjustments and fixes to the block-editor insertion flow.

0.4.0

  • First version with the Legal Module (legal-risk language alert) for the Pro plan.

0.1.0

  • Initial release: draft structuring, suggested headlines, summary, pull quotes and meta description.
